Package com.example.volt.selected

Class SelectedDestinationsAdapter

java.lang.Object
androidx.recyclerview.widget.RecyclerView.Adapter<SelectedDestinationsAdapter.ViewHolder>
com.ernestoyaquello.dragdropswiperecyclerview.DragDropSwipeAdapter<Destination,SelectedDestinationsAdapter.ViewHolder>
com.example.volt.selected.SelectedDestinationsAdapter
public class SelectedDestinationsAdapter extends com.ernestoyaquello.dragdropswiperecyclerview.DragDropSwipeAdapter<Destination,SelectedDestinationsAdapter.ViewHolder>
An adapter that manages a list of Destination objects for display in a RecyclerView with drag-and-drop reordering and swipe-to-remove support.

Representation Invariant:

  • None

Abstraction Function:

SelectedDestinationsAdapter sda represents a link between the collection of Destination to the View that displays them such that:
  • sda.onItemRemovedBySwipingListener is an object that is notified when a View is removed by swiping
